disclaimer: Illustrative planning values for demos only. Tax rates, withholding and treaty treatment change and depend on the facts — validate with local tax counsel and Wursta Finance before quoting.

MX.name: Mexico

vat.name: IVA
vat.cross_border_note: Imported services: the client may self-assess IVA; Wursta's USD invoice carries no IVA (confirm with counsel).

MX.withholding_note: Planning rate for technical services paid abroad; treaty relief may reduce it to 0% with a US tax-residency certificate.
MX.data_protection_law: Federal law on personal data held by private parties
MX.payment_terms_norm: Net 30-45; client PO and supplier registration required

CO.name: Colombia

vat.name: IVA
vat.cross_border_note: Services rendered from abroad: client applies reverse-charge IVA (illustrative).

CO.withholding_note: Planning rate for services and technical assistance paid abroad; no US-Colombia income tax treaty.
CO.e_invoicing: Factura electrónica validated by DIAN (local partner billing)
CO.payment_terms_norm: Net 30-60; RUT and supplier onboarding required
CO.governing_law_default: Colombian law, Bogota courts or arbitration

BR.name: Brazil

vat.name: ISS + PIS/COFINS (no single VAT)
vat.cross_border_note: Import of services can attract IRRF, CIDE, PIS/COFINS-Importação, ISS and IOF on FX — combined burden can exceed 35% (illustrative).

BR.withholding_note: Planning IRRF rate on technical-service remittances; CIDE 10% and other import taxes are usually borne by the client but must be clear in the contract.
BR.payment_terms_norm: Net 30-45; contract in Portuguese for public or large private clients
BR.governing_law_default: Brazilian law, Sao Paulo courts or arbitration

CL.name: Chile

vat.name: IVA
vat.cross_border_note: Services from abroad may be subject to IVA withheld by the client (illustrative).

CL.withholding_note: Planning rate for technical services from abroad (impuesto adicional); higher rates can apply.
CL.e_invoicing: DTE before the SII (local partner billing)
CL.data_protection_law: Chilean personal data protection law (update in implementation)

PE.name: Peru

vat.name: IGV
vat.cross_border_note: Client pays IGV on use of services from abroad (illustrative).

PE.withholding_note: Planning rate for technical assistance to non-domiciled providers; digital services and other services can attract 30%.
PE.e_invoicing: Comprobante electronico before SUNAT (local partner billing)

SV.name: El Salvador

vat.name: IVA
vat.cross_border_note: Services from non-domiciled providers: client may withhold/assess IVA (illustrative).

SV.withholding_note: Planning rate for payments to non-domiciled service providers.
SV.e_invoicing: DTE (Ministerio de Hacienda) via local partner
SV.data_protection_law: Salvadoran personal data protection rules in force
SV.payment_terms_norm: Net 30; public-sector clients follow procurement law timelines
